title: Non-metal single atoms anchored on defective MoS2: a novel electrocatalyst for NO reduction to NH3
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29323-29334
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04718H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yifan Liu, Mamutjan Tursun, Guangzhi Hu, Abdukader Abdukayum, Chao Wu
The eNORR performance of the MoS2 catalyst doped with non-metal atoms has been studied. The Si, C, N, B, and P@MoS2 catalysts demonstrated great potential for eNORR. The Si, C, and B@MoS2 catalysts inhibited the formation of byproducts and HER.
